\section{Exit-code probe}

A deliberately deadlocking specification. The initial state sets $count = 0$
and the only operation requires $count > 0$, so no operation is ever enabled
and ProB must report a deadlock. Used once, to establish whether probcli
signals a counterexample through its exit status or only through its output.

\begin{zed}
  maxCount == 3
\end{zed}

\begin{schema}{Probe}
  count : \nat
\where
  count \leq maxCount
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{InitProbe}
  Probe'
\where
  count' = 0
\end{schema}

\begin{schema}{Step}
  \Delta Probe
\where
  count > 0 \\
  count' = count - 1
\end{schema}
